# Modern Furniture Gallery

> Luxury custom furniture manufacturer and showroom in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) since 2000. Makes custom sofas, sectionals, beds, accent chairs and ottomans for homes, and restaurant booths, banquettes, club and lounge booths and commercial seating for restaurants, cafés, bars, lounges and offices. Everything is built to order in Mississauga and sold factory-direct at wholesaler prices.

- Address: 7025 Tomken Rd #19, Mississauga, ON L5S 1R6, Canada
- Phone: (905) 956-9200
- Hours: Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Saturday 11 a.m.–8 p.m., Sunday 12–6 p.m.
- Website: https://modernfurnituregallery.ca/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3011945968917261082
- Areas served: Mississauga, Toronto, Brampton, Oakville, Vaughan, Etobicoke, North York, Scarborough, Markham, Richmond Hill, Milton, Burlington and all of Ontario
- Commercial clients include Crab Boil, Habibz Corner and Nikon
- Pricing: every piece is custom and quoted to order; no fixed prices
- Typical turnaround: most custom pieces 1–3 weeks
